mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dashed trace is a cubic-shaped function graph used for comparison with the solid trace. Right image: The dashed arc shows the hidden part of the cylinder’s circular bottom rim.
Rationales: The feature plots the values of a function in the left image and shows the occluded part of the circular rim of a solid in the right image. The red dashed increasing cubic-shaped curve to the right of the blue trace. The dashed arc at the rear of the lower cylinder rim.
